description: Ministry of Defence - Amending the List of Designated Persons published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1941/44 of 20.11.2015 by the repeal of the schedules thereto and by substitution of the schedules therefor
reasoning: This gazette content amends the list of designated persons under the United Nations Regulations, specifically modifying the list published in a previous gazette. It involves legal/regulatory matters by updating statutory instruments and compliance requirements related to terrorism financing and activities under the United Nations Act. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial activities, elections, public service, judicial appointments, or other specialized categories, making Legal/Regulatory the appropriate classification.
